environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY action override to Count, and (2) a custom rule group 'corp-api-protection' containing a RegexPatternSet rule that inspects JsonBody with paths '/sort' and '/order' against pattern '^[a-zA-Z_]{1,30}$' with BLOCK action and priority 1. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the custom rule fires on non-alphanumeric sort/order values. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to S3 with Athena queries for forensics, and the ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS endpoint via security group reference.

rules.name: block-injection-in-sort-params
rules.logic: BLOCK if value does NOT match pattern (negated regex match)

config.network_egress: ECS task SG allows outbound only to RDS SG on port 5432
config.logging: ALB access logs to S3, WAF logs to CloudWatch Logs
